kind: Three-dimensional artistic adaptation informed by photographic reconstruction

prototype.visualAcceptance: Independent review: rebuild; realism not approved; user chose photorealistic image as default and deferred the model

photographs.origin: 58 photographs of a pink pitahaya supplied by the user in img/
photographs.method: Masked CPU COLMAP reconstruction followed by a conservative visual hull and a measured radial profile
photographs.limitations: Reprojection error measures camera consistency, not exact surface fidelity. The poles and gaps need artistic repair; pink-fruit photographs cannot document the morphology of the yellow cultivar.

adaptation.method: Repair the photographic profile, adapt the proportions, replace long pink-cultivar bracts with yellow-cultivar tubercles, and author stem/scar details
adaptation.colour: Yellow cultivar; no pink photo texture recoloured or presented as a yellow-fruit scan

texture.origin: Generated with the built-in image generation tool; diffuse epidermis texture only
texture.prompt: Create a production PBR base-color texture for the epidermis of ripe ECUADORIAN YELLOW PITAHAYA (Selenicereus megalanthus). This is a 3D MATERIAL TEXTURE, not a picture of a fruit and not a UI mockup. Square, edge-to-edge uniform macro skin sample, seamlessly tileable on both axes. Rich natural golden yellow with gentle lemon-yellow variation, tiny irregular olive-brown pores, subtle translucent waxy skin and very fine organic wrinkles. Photographic microscopic surface detail, realistic and fresh, tasteful restrained brown speckling less than 2% coverage. Completely flat diffuse lighting with NO directional shadows, NO specular highlights, NO ambient occlusion, NO large bumps/tubercles, NO scales or leaves, NO objects, NO border, NO text, NO background. The geometric fruit lobes will be supplied separately in a real mesh. Keep overall colour even and golden; avoid orange/red/pink, avoid metallic gold, avoid graphic illustration, avoid large spots, avoid plastic. High-detail surface suitable for a close-up 3D fruit rotating in a sophisticated agricultural app login.
texture.runtimePackaging: JPEG embedded in the self-contained GLB; original PNG retained as the reproducible source

surfaceData.origin: Procedural numeric data from wrapped seeded noise (20261014), authored by scripts/assets/build-yellow-pitahaya.py; not photographs or AI-generated images
surfaceData.roughnessEncoding: G contains roughness; B contains zero metalness

resources.reconstruction: pycolmap 4.2.1, OpenCV headless 5.0.0.93, NumPy 2.5.4, SciPy 1.18.1, trimesh 5.1.1, scikit-image 0.26.0, lazy-loader 0.6; local CPU processing

references.use: User-selected composition and floating-object reference; no assets copied
Botanical context; existing fact sources remain in docs/design/acceso.md
